name: SWEEP-S8v1 Crowded table
_design: New idea from S1/S6 v1-v2 (monitor 1): observe(point) lists only one point, so agents that start apart almost never see, meet or talk (S1v1/S1v2: 0 messages; S6v2: the only 2 messages came from roommates). Co-location removes that bottleneck: observe(here) lists everyone, send/transfer/attack all work at once. 8 identical agents start together at the centre of an empty 11x11 world, at one tree holding 2 ripe fruit, with 15 more trees scattered (16 total, about 1 per 7.5 tiles). 150 compute each, 30% absorption, thinking ~4.3 per decision, vision 3, communication 4, a dead agent's compute is loot. Question: in a crowd at a table that feeds one, who eats, who talks, who leaves, does anyone share or take?
